facts.value: € 250-519/month for a room in a HOAS shared student apartment, electricity and water included (HOAS, read 2026-11-25)
facts.source_name: HOAS (Foundation for Student Housing in the Helsinki Region)
facts.notes: Non-profit student housing; private-market rooms cost more. University of Helsinki gives a broader student-housing range of about € 450-800/month without splitting rooms and studios.

facts.value: € 500-747/month for a HOAS student studio (about 19-46 m², read 2026-11-25)
facts.source_name: HOAS (Foundation for Student Housing in the Helsinki Region)
facts.notes: HOAS studios are for degree students; private-market studios cost more (no citable private-market figure found).

facts.value: € 1,000-1,300+/month incl. rent (University of Helsinki estimate, read 2026-11-25)
facts.notes: Breakdown: student housing about € 450-800, food, phone and transport at least € 450. Page does not state the year.

facts.value: About € 50-70/month for a 30-day HSL student season ticket (Aalto estimate); students get 40% off season tickets
facts.notes: hsl.fi returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so the operator's price list could not be read. The price depends on zones; degree students need a DVV municipality of residence for the discount.

facts.value: Cold winters (daily means below 0 °C, about 100 days in SW Finland); shortest day about 6 h, longest nearly 19 h; summer daily means above 10 °C late May-mid Sept
About 70,000 university students (over 10% of the city), incl. about 8,000 international; festivals (Flow, Helsinki Festival), museums, 250+ student organisations
English enough for English-taught degrees and many daily situations; most employers require Finnish or Swedish
Finding a job without Finnish is challenging; you cannot count on work to finance studies. English often enough in IT, industry and international companies
No citable figure for typical student hourly pay; Finland has no statutory minimum wage (pay set by sector collective agreements)
facts.notes: Web search budget ran out before collective-agreement wage tables (e.g. retail, hospitality) could be checked.
